title: Frechet differentiability from the integral mean-value formula
statement: Let n, l >= 0, f : R^n -> R^l, g : R^n -> L(R^n, R^l), U ⊆ R^n open and x ∈ U. Suppose g is continuous on U and f(y) - f(x) = integral_0^1 g(x + tau(y - x))(y - x) dtau for every y ∈ U. Then f has Frechet derivative g(x) at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (U : Set (Rn n)) (x : Rn n), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → ContinuousOn g U → (∀ y ∈ U, f y - f x = ∫ τ in (0:ℝ)..1, g (x + τ • (y - x)) (y - x)) → HasFDerivAt f (g x) x
